plugins.name: eslint-plugin-browser-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for browser security — detects DOM XSS, postMessage abuse, tokens in localStorage, insecure cookies, clickjacking, mixed content, and CSP gaps

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-node-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for Node.js security — detects command injection, path traversal, SSRF, zip slip, and weak crypto (MD5/SHA-1, ECB, static IV) in fs, child_process, vm, and crypto

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-secure-coding
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for secure coding — detects LDAP, XPath, XXE, GraphQL and template injection, unsafe deserialization, ReDoS, missing authentication, and PII in logs

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-vercel-ai-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for Vercel AI SDK security — detects prompt injection, system-prompt leaks, hardcoded API keys, and unvalidated model output in generateText and streamText

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-mongodb-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for MongoDB and Mongoose security — detects NoSQL operator injection, unsafe queries and regex, hardcoded connection strings, and missing TLS

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-jwt-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for JWT security — detects algorithm confusion (CVE-2022-23540), alg:none, weak or hardcoded secrets, and decode-without-verify

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-postgresql-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for the pg PostgreSQL driver — detects SQL injection, unreleased clients, floating queries, unsafe search_path, and insecure SSL

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-knex-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for knex — detects SQL injection in raw queries built with string concatenation or template literals, connection configuration that disables TLS or certificate validation, and hardcoded database credentials

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-drizzle-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for drizzle-orm — detects SQL injection in raw queries built with string concatenation or template literals

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-mcp-sdk-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK security — catches tools registered without an input schema, handlers reading arguments the schema never declared, model-visible descriptions built from dynamic text, and tool arguments reaching a shell

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-prisma-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for @prisma/client — detects SQL injection in raw queries built with string concatenation or template literals

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-sequelize-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for the Sequelize ORM — detects SQL injection in raw sequelize.query() and Sequelize.literal() calls built with string concatenation or template literals, connection configuration that disables TLS or certificate validation, and hardcoded database credentials

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-typeorm-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for typeorm — detects SQL injection in raw queries built with string concatenation or template literals, connection configuration that disables TLS or certificate validation, and hardcoded database credentials

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-anthropic-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for Anthropic SDK security — catches hardcoded Claude API keys, the browser escape hatch that ships them to every visitor, and system prompts assembled from untrusted input

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-gemini-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for Google Gemini SDK security — catches safety thresholds set to BLOCK_NONE, hardcoded API keys, and system instructions assembled from untrusted input

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-mysql-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for mysql2 / mysql — detects SQL injection in raw queries built with string concatenation or template literals, connection configuration that disables TLS or certificate validation, and hardcoded database credentials

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-openai-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for OpenAI SDK security — catches dangerouslyAllowBrowser, hardcoded API keys, and system prompts assembled from untrusted input

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-sqlite-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for better-sqlite3 / sqlite3 — detects SQL injection in raw queries built with string concatenation or template literals

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-express-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for Express.js security — detects permissive CORS, missing CSRF protection, missing helmet headers, insecure cookies, and GraphQL introspection in production

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-lambda-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for AWS Lambda security — detects overly permissive IAM policies and CORS, unvalidated event bodies, secrets in env vars, and leaked error details

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-nestjs-security
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for NestJS security — detects missing auth guards, missing validation pipes, unthrottled routes, and exposed private fields

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-import-next
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for imports and module boundaries — drop-in replacement for eslint-plugin-import, 3.1x faster end-to-end, zero-config migration

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-conventions
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for team code conventions — enforces filename case, magic-number bans, commented-out code, expiring TODOs, and deprecated-API usage

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-maintainability
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for maintainable code — limits cognitive complexity, nesting depth, parameter counts, duplicate functions, and unhandled or silent errors

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-reliability
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for runtime reliability — enforces error handling, network timeouts, null checks, and safe type narrowing

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-modularity
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for module architecture — enforces DDD value objects and anemic-model checks, naming, REST conventions, and utility isolation

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-operability
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for production operability — bans debug code and console logging in production, verbose error messages, and process.exit calls

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-modernization
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for modernizing JavaScript — auto-fixes legacy patterns to ES2022+ (Array.at, template literals, EventTarget, Array.isArray)

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-react-features
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for React — hooks, prop-types, JSX correctness, render performance, and class-to-hooks migration rules for modern React codebases

plugins.name: eslint-plugin-react-a11y
plugins.description: ESLint plugin for React accessibility — WCAG 2.1 rules for ARIA, alt text, keyboard interaction, and focus management, with auto-fixes
